title: Paperless OCR Queue Backlog
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=paperless:document
| stats count(eval(status="queued")) as queued_docs, count(eval(status="processing")) as processing_docs by consumer
| where queued_docs>20 OR processing_docs>5
| sort - queued_docs
description: Uses Paperless-ngx ingestion events telemetry to monitor how far OCR and import queues are backing up in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for document backlogs before scanning confidence drops, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Paperless-ngx ingestion events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Consumer table of queued and processing documents.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how far OCR and import queues are backing up so you can spot document backlogs before scanning confidence drops before it becomes annoying.
